narratives.Description: leftover(#633): pre-PR skill skip and omitted checklist stay undetectable
narratives.Origin: Prefer-A leftover-complete after product PR #5280; Bound leftover-deliver lean 5799283607 (Target-digest sha256:630330e440cbd9da518bee0ecbfdbb2de2b53cfc8e8b5e77b8cac575a319ebf5).
narratives.Overview:
Controller-issued pre-PR completion records (Limbs 1–4 + Limb 6 tests) landed in #5280. Merge authority is a private-store record matching the live PR binding. App/ruleset enrollment and live skip detection stay on #4976. Filed implementing-agent skip P1 remains does-not-relieve until that enrollment harvest.

Bound remedy clauses:
1. Recut merge-authority on this number: a required check proves a controller-observed pre-PR workflow for the bound inputs. Local implementing-agent skill invocation stays outside that proof. Change `content/skills/deft-directive-pre-pr/SKILL.md` in the same unit so the anti-pattern matches that recut.
2. Reuse the Directive GitHub App private store (#4494 remaining deploy) or SLizard's hosted App identity. Do not mint a third App, store, or ruleset product. Sequence enrollment behind that remaining deploy.
3. Name a versioned per-phase observable table the controller fail-closes without reviewer prose as authority. Reviewer emits a closed-schema report. Publisher validates schema and file-manifest equality. Missing Diff, truncated delivery, or post-gate fix without rereview fails.
4. Name the authoritative scope and criteria snapshot from base-approved provenance. Compose existing `scope-provenance` and intent-evaluate. Same-PR criteria weakening and PR-substituted gate definitions fail closed.
5. Enrollment: required context name plus `integration_id` of that App. Turn `strict_required_status_checks_policy` on if base SHA is merge-authority. Live probe: after success, change a supported non-head input and attempt merge; stale success must not merge.
6. Artifact-only: publish a positive success record with reason artifact-only. Do not skip the check.
7. Merge authority is a matching successful record on the final head. Pre-creation pass is telemetry on the existing #1703 Tier-1 surface, not a second merge gate.
8. Fail-closed read-only Write: the controller refuses until the snapshot would be a no-change pass. The authoring agent still Writes.
